proposal_contract.failure_or_rollback_triggers: Negative stress or winner-removal economics, continued single-side evidence, source mismatch, unresolved lifecycle paths, poor depth at intended size, fee or funding deterioration, or correlated loss concentration beyond the declared portfolio budget.
